title: Desk Mode
summary: Plug in HDMI, get the Pi desktop, type on the Cardputer's own keyboard
description:
Desk Mode turns the CardputerZero into a small desktop computer: plug in an HDMI display and the Raspberry Pi desktop starts on it, while the built-in screen and the launcher keep working.

**HDMI desktop**
- Starts automatically when HDMI is plugged in (can be switched off), or from the app.
- Runs as your user, without LightDM and without root. LightDM's login screen starts a second audio server that takes the sound card from the launcher and can freeze it; Desk Mode avoids that.
- Nothing runs while HDMI is unplugged. Close the desktop from the app (frees ~55 MB of RAM), or let Battery Saver close it 1 min after HDMI is unplugged (its default).

**Built-in keyboard on the HDMI display**
- Each time HDMI is plugged in, the built-in screen lights up and asks whether the keyboard should go to the HDMI display (or set it to always / never).
- Symbols typed with Sym come out right on the desktop (the keyboard sends non-standard codes for them; Desk Mode translates).
- Ctrl+Alt+Esc gives the keyboard back to the Cardputer. Unplugging HDMI or closing the desktop does too, and the built-in screen wakes up.
- While the keyboard is on the HDMI display, the built-in screen turns off to save power.

Keys: F/X move, Enter change, I info, Esc back.
